svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar of frosted pills whose Switchyard signal is amber with a 2: two builds are going. A click springs the board out of it: Projects, Deploys, Desk, History, Inspection and Shelf tabs, the main line with its memory gauge, and eight tiles. storefront finishes on the main line and android takes its place, then ledger-api fails and the signal turns red. A click on its tile opens the log on the TypeScript error, and y copies it with context. The board closes with the signal still red until a right-click acknowledges the failure.
